low_level: Registers 36 to 255 over the 476 distinct kernels behind the card's cells (128 with register spills, a kernel measured in more than one batch counts once), shared memory 544 to 71680 bytes, harness 0.10 on umbriel-b200-047, umbriel-b200-068.
Adapter statics: input arrangement blocked, output indices, temp storage 512 to 768 bytes.

algorithmic: Random input (the one-node matrix on umbriel-b200-047): latency not_guaranteed wins 20 of 89 cells (runner-up in 27), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 18 of 70 cells (runner-up in 16), throughput not_guaranteed wins 15 of 87 cells (runner-up in 23), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 17 of 70 cells (runner-up in 14).

Where it wins on random input (bf16 N 256, bf16 N 512, bf16 N 2048, bf16 N 4096, fp32 N 128, fp32 N 256, fp32 N 512, fp32 N 1024 and more), the median margin over the runner-up is +22 percent and over the scope's reference control +370 percent.

Largest random-input deficits (distinct cells, worst regime): fp32 N 4096 k 16 +1679 percent behind W5_v4 in throughput not_guaranteed, fp32 N 4096 k 4 +1155 percent behind W5_v4 in throughput not_guaranteed, bf16 N 4096 k 4 +1048 percent behind W5_v4 in throughput prefer_smaller_index, bf16 N 4096 k 16 +1045 percent behind W5_v4 in throughput prefer_smaller_index.

Tie-heavy input (unshuffled, umbriel-b200-068): latency not_guaranteed wins 17 of 42 cells (runner-up in 12), latency prefer_smaller_index wins 16 of 39 cells (runner-up in 12), throughput not_guaranteed wins 21 of 42 cells (runner-up in 8), throughput prefer_smaller_index wins 20 of 39 cells (runner-up in 8).

negative: No cell where this adapter was the winner changed hands against the control in the same lock section. Deficits above are against other adapters of the same scope.
surprises: None beyond what the tables show.
